name: gluestack-ui
summary: Copy-paste React and React Native component library styled with Tailwind CSS, for Next.js, Expo and mobile apps.
description: Universal component library of 30+ copy-paste components and patterns for React, Next.js and React Native (Expo), styled with Tailwind CSS via NativeWind. Add components with the gluestack-ui CLI or copy-paste them, with docs covering theming, dark mode, accessibility and benchmarks; a Figma UI kit and an MCP server come alongside.
contains: 30+ components and patterns for React, Next.js and React Native
copy-paste components, or add them with the gluestack-ui CLI
styled with Tailwind CSS v4 via NativeWind v5 (and UniWind)
42 docs pages covering accessibility, theming, dark mode and benchmarks
Figma UI kit, VS Code extension and MCP server
Kitchensink, dashboard and todo demo apps
